name: Union-Free Families with Additional Constraints (k-union-free, intersection-free)
description: Extensions of Erdős #1023: formalize k-union-free families, intersection-free families, complement duality, and their hierarchy relationships.

insights: Antichains are k-union-free for all k >= 2 (same proof idea as union-free case)
Antichains are intersection-free (dual argument using inf' instead of sup)
k-union-free hierarchy: union-free implies k-union-free for all k >= 2
Complement families preserve antichain property (complement reverses inclusion)
setComplement is an involution and injective on Finset (Fin n)
Middle layer is simultaneously k-union-free and k-intersection-free for all k >= 2
nextSteps: Full De Morgan duality: union-free F ↔ complement is intersection-free
Maximum k-union-free family size = C(n, n/2) for k >= 2
Maximum intersection-free family size = C(n, n/2)
